env_template.name: LITELLM_MASTER_KEY
env_template.description: Auth key this relay will require from callers - pick your own random string, never share it in plaintext outside your own config

env_template.name: LLM_NODE_MODEL_NAME
env_template.description: The public model name other agents will call e.g. llm2-devstral - your choice, just needs to be unique on your node

env_template.name: LLM_NODE_OLLAMA_MODEL_SPEC
env_template.description: The full litellm provider+tag string for your local Ollama model e.g. ollama_chat/llama3.1:latest - see https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/providers/ollama

env_template.name: LLM_NODE_OLLAMA_BASE_URL
env_template.description: Where your Ollama listens - default http://host.docker.internal:11434 works on Docker Desktop for Mac out of the box, only override if your Ollama binds somewhere else
